args.title: Fix issue 4403 in src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts controls CSV export and has a CsvOptions option bom, which prefixes a byte order mark by default (bom = true). The BOM constant is '\ufeff'. This is deliberate for spreadsheet apps to detect UTF-8, so if changes are needed, they would be done here.
